title: Sprint 4 — Task Updates, Deletions, and Filtering
description: Implement task modifications, completion toggles, deletions, and status query parameter filtering in Express.
lab_title: Node.js & Express Todo REST API Lab

tickets.title: Ticket 1 - Update Task & Status Toggle API
tickets.description:
Build `PUT` and `PATCH /api/tasks/:id` in `src/routes/tasks.js` to allow updating a task's title, description, or completion status (`is_completed`).

### Request Header
`Authorization: Bearer <jwt_token>`

### Request Body (Partial or Full)
```json
{
  "title": "Updated Title",
  "is_completed": true
}
```

### Requirements
1. Protect endpoint with `authenticateToken` middleware.
2. Verify the task belongs to `req.user.id`. Return `404 Not Found` if missing or unauthorized.
3. Update fields if provided in request body. If `title` is provided, validate it is not empty (HTTP 400).
4. Update `task.updated_at` to current timestamp.
5. Commit to database and return `200 OK` with `{"message": "Task updated successfully", "task": {...}}`.
learning_objectives: Support partial and full REST resource updates in Express.
Update timestamp columns on record changes.

tasks.title: Return HTTP 200 with updated task payload.

common_mistakes: Allowing empty string titles to overwrite valid titles.
Not validating ownership before applying updates.

tickets.title: Ticket 2 - Delete Task API
tickets.description:
Build `DELETE /api/tasks/:id` to allow users to permanently delete a task.

### Request Header
`Authorization: Bearer <jwt_token>`

### Requirements
1. Protect endpoint with `authenticateToken` middleware.
2. Verify the task belongs to `req.user.id`. Return `404 Not Found` if missing or unauthorized.
3. Delete the task record from the database.
4. Return `200 OK` with `{"message": "Task deleted successfully"}`.
learning_objectives: Implement resource deletion in REST APIs using Express.
Enforce horizontal authorization on DELETE requests.
Handle database deletion operations in SQLite.

tasks.title: Enforce ownership authorization on task deletion.
Delete task from database and return HTTP 200.

common_mistakes: Deleting another user's task without ownership validation.
Returning success even when the task does not exist.

tickets.title: Ticket 3 - Task Filtering by Status Query Parameter
tickets.description:
Enhance `GET /api/tasks` to support query parameter filtering by completion status: `?completed=true` or `?completed=false`.

### Requirements
1. If `?completed=true` is passed in URL query string, return only tasks where `is_completed === true`.
2. If `?completed=false` is passed, return only tasks where `is_completed === false`.
3. If `completed` parameter is omitted or empty, return all tasks for the current user as before.
4. All tasks must still strictly belong to `req.user.id`.
learning_objectives: Read and parse URL query parameters using `req.query` in Express.
Apply dynamic SQL filtering based on request criteria.
Combine user authorization with custom query filtering conditions.

tasks.title: Apply dynamic filtering on database query based on parameter value.
Return filtered tasks list with HTTP 200.

common_mistakes: Treating string `'false'` as boolean truthy in JavaScript (`Boolean('false') === true`). Compare string values: `val === 'true'`.
Overriding user ownership filter when applying status filter.
hints: If `completed !== undefined`, test `const isComp = completed === 'true' || completed === '1';`.
